# Mac App Store preparation

Open-source app, paid-upfront download. No subscription, account, cloud service,
receipt lock, built-in updater, shell helper or firmware installer is included.
This directory prepares a Store build; it is not evidence of Store approval.

## Local validation

Requires Xcode 26, macOS 14+ and XcodeGen. No Apple credentials are needed:

```sh
xcodegen generate --spec Store/project.yml
xcodebuild -project Store/BLEClipboardStore.xcodeproj -scheme BLEClipboardStore \
  -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' \
  -derivedDataPath Store/DerivedData build CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=-
```

The development app is `Store/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug/BLE Clipboard.app`.
Debug has the separate `.MacrosPreview` bundle ID. `--ui-testing`
disables Bluetooth and uses a temporary library for UI tests. Do not use that
flag for hardware tests. Source-only checks:

```sh
swift test --package-path BLEClipboardMac
sh scripts/check_clipboard.sh
sh scripts/archive_store.sh
```

The archive script defaults to unsigned validation only. It does not upload,
change accounts, install firmware or create signing certificates. The Xcode
target enables App Sandbox, Bluetooth and user-selected read/write files. It
does not request Accessibility, Full Disk Access, network client/server or root.
The Store and direct-download targets share the independent 0.3.0 Quick Paste,
Macros, binary compiler and CoreBluetooth client. Use the matching independently
built `ble_clipboard.fap` under Apps > Bluetooth. No vendor submodule, compatibility
overlay or third-party execution backend is needed. Old public/submitted 0.1.x
artifacts stay unchanged and are not this version.
Clipboard access is explicit and no monitoring API is installed.

## Distribution gates

1. Resolve the licensing and rights review in `metadata/RIGHTS.md`. Do not submit
   GPL-covered material with conflicting recipient restrictions or invent
   permission to relicense third-party work. Retain all corresponding source.
2. Owner confirms the selling team/legal entity, app name, bundle ID, SKU,
   paid price, territories, support contact and privacy-policy URL. Release
   currently defaults to `com.oguzcanunver.BLEClipboardMac`; confirm ownership
   before registering it. Debug intentionally uses another ID.
3. Account Holder handles paid agreements, tax/banking and any required trader
   declarations in App Store Connect. Developer membership alone is not enough.
4. Configure the proper Mac App Store distribution signing identity, matching
   provisioning profile and export settings in Xcode. Developer ID certificates
   are for direct distribution, not Store submission. Do not commit secrets,
   profiles, private keys or account tokens.
5. Pass physical BLE/USB, focus, large-transfer, layout, cancellation, power-loss
   and clean-install tests in `metadata/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md`.
6. Archive signed Release using Xcode Organizer (or the explicit script mode
   below); validate and upload to App Store Connect. Review export-compliance
   answers based on actual system Bluetooth encryption; no declaration is
   prefilled in Info.plist as a substitute for that review.
7. Internal TestFlight, external beta/review if used, physical demonstration
   video and reviewer instructions. Record real feedback and failures.
8. Review final metadata/privacy/age rating/price, submit for review, respond to
   Apple, then owner approves manual release. Test the Store-installed version.

For a signed archive, after the release gates and local signing are configured:

```sh
STORE_RIGHTS_REVIEWED=YES STORE_HARDWARE_TESTED=YES \
DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=YOUR_TEAM_ID sh scripts/archive_store.sh --signed
```

This flag is an owner assertion, not proof generated by the script. It must not
be set automatically by CI. Upload stays a separate deliberate Organizer action.
Signed mode also requires `STORE_SIGNING_IDENTITY` (the complete Store certificate
name) and `STORE_PROFILE` (matching provisioning profile specifier); it rejects
Developer ID and development identities. Set `STORE_BUILD_NUMBER` for each upload.
The generated project and archive/result directories are ignored. Commit source
and `project.yml`; regenerate the project instead of hand-editing it.

## Source archives

CI attaches project and Flipper source alongside development binaries.
`sh scripts/package_sources.sh` snapshots allowlisted current project source,
including local changes but excluding build products, keys and account files.
`sh scripts/build_flipper.sh` includes its exact C/header source and fingerprints.
An archive-only checkout needs only the project archive and the public pinned
Flipper SDK/toolchain; there is no secondary engine archive/submodule to install.

These artifacts make the tested source available with the binaries; they do not
replace review of Store agreements, source obligations or a permanent source
release matching an actual submission.
